text: The record keeps lone sod as a cross name. It sends the reader to the full entry, stray sod. A stray sod is a charm of a patch of grass laid loose on the road. The magic of the grass made a passing woman or man stumble, and the path turned strange. The name lone sod calls back to that same stray sod as a second way of speaking.
